title: West Virginia Legislature cyberattack, Nov 19, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by the West Virginia Legislature, the State of West Virginia, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One body, the state legislature's IT systems and website. The Legislature says other state agencies do not appear to be affected, and legislative work continued.
who_is_affected: Legislative staff and lawmakers, and anyone trying to use the Legislature's website. Whether anyone's personal information was involved is still being reviewed; the Legislature says it will meet any notification obligations.

known.text: The Legislature says it identified a cybersecurity incident affecting its IT systems on Nov 19.
It disabled access to some IT systems, and its website went down.

not_known.text: Whether any personal or sensitive information was taken.
Whether the website and systems are back.
